observation: oracle occupancy has a 10/28 zero-false-safe upper bound while two learned argmax backends reproduce the same accepts with 10/10 false-safe
diagnosis: the missing mechanism is evidence authority and selective abstention, not another backend
decision: freeze CPSC around hard sensor evidence, defeasible prior and UNKNOWN; preserve V6.1 and lock fresh evaluation tiers

observation: uncertainty, evidential unknown, conformal sets, 4D query supervision, withheld-evidence completion and differentiable hard constraints all have primary-source precedents, while no source found the full driving-world compiler conjunction
diagnosis: component novelty is unavailable but a task-level and interface-level contribution remains
decision: narrow CPSC to hard-evidence-constrained physical-state compilation and implement a separable closed-form projection before dataset construction

observation: tri-state evidence constraints are query-wise separable and require no iterative solver
diagnosis: closed-form one-hot replacement is sufficient for hard evidence while softmax can remain differentiable on unconstrained queries
decision: promote the minimal operator after one synthetic test and one real O_method fixture; defer proximal energies to a later single-factor hypothesis only if data/training requires them

observation: the complete six-scene V4 validation cohort predates V6.2, is metadata-selected, lies in nuScenes train and is fully processed with 191 to 196 frames

decision: freeze all six scenes, twelve stride-15 targets per scene, rotating even-offset dropout and independent odd-offset targets

observation: one real target produced all six query pools, 100k rows in about 2MB and three seconds, with zero source-role overlap; the probe also exposed incompatible evidence-state and model-class integer orderings
diagnosis: the dataset is resource-feasible, but unnamed integer labels would create a silent training bug
decision: store explicit evidence-state and remapped class-index arrays, resolve V62-F02, freeze two workers and proceed directly to full materialization without more smoke

diagnosis: instantaneous target envelopes are not a complete actor-query support for enter/exit trajectories; deleting the unit or reallocating its actor quota would bias the frozen distribution
decision: use the union of current target and visible method-sweep actor envelopes only as query support, preserve the 15k actor quota, and keep hard occupancy evidence unchanged
